source_text: Ecce tu pulcher es, dilecte mi, et decorus. Cubile nostrum umbrosum. Nunc primum sponsa attentius pulchritudinem sponsi inspicit illis oculis qui columbae dicti sunt. Cubile commune corpus animae intelligitur, in quo adhuc posita ad consortium Verbi assumitur. Umbrosum: non aridum, sed densitate bonorum operum nemorosum.
pass_a_gloss: Behold you fair are, beloved my, and graceful. Couch our shaded. Now first bride more-carefully beauty of-bridegroom inspects with-those eyes which doves are-said...
pass_b_english: [[Behold, you are fair, my beloved, and graceful. Our couch is shaded >> Bible:Song of Songs 1:16]]. Now first the Bride more carefully inspects the Bridegroom’s beauty with those eyes called doves. The shared couch is understood as the soul’s body, in which, while still placed there, she is counted worthy to be taken into partnership with the Word. Shaded: not dry, but wooded with the density of good works.
